outcomes.title: Expose Or Refuse
outcomes.consequences: The player reports supported facts or declines further involvement. The story records that choice without requiring vigilantism, participation in theft, or a romantic rescue.

title: The Unplanted Harvest
setup: During a greenhouse visit, Imani shows you a plant growing in a bed with no matching cultivation record. It thrives through a minor equipment interruption that damages neighboring crops. Residents hear about a possible food breakthrough before the team knows whether the organism is safe or even truly new.
opening: I know everything we planted in this house. That is why I would like you to look at this.
guidance: Help communicate the finding accurately, trace the bed's history, or support a contained study while ordinary food supplies continue. Imani must balance wonder with the pressure to promise a solution to people who need one.

chapters.title: A contained comparison
chapters.guidance: Invite an investigation, not a completed discovery. Imani and Ari design a contained study, Hana traces the water path, and Liora tests an ordinary horticultural explanation. Reveal only evidence actually examined by this player; do not reveal the later resolution upfront.

chapters.title: What the ordinary explanation covers
chapters.guidance: If the evidence has been examined, explore this disagreement: Sora asks what residents were promised; Liora needs stewardship and Imani needs accountable yields. Author-only bounded truth, to reveal only when earned: The horticultural explanation accounts for some observations but not all. Unknown organisms are not established as safe food.

chapters.title: A promise to the orchard
chapters.guidance: Present an unresolved decision. Offer a contained trial, protected bed, or limited publication. Record only the choice actually made; do not feed unknown organisms to residents to advance a scene. If no decision is established in this session, leave it open. Respect any recorded decision instead of replaying it. The scene may remain friendship-only.
